what_happened: Both measurement instruments the cost baseline needs already exist with no new dependency: Mathlib's #count_heartbeats in <cmd> (Mathlib/Util/CountHeartbeats.lean, present in the pinned v4.33.0-rc1 tree) and Lean.Expr.sizeWithoutSharing. Five lean_run_code probes produced the whole baseline inside research, including an exact closed form for lintro nesting cost (5n^2+17n+41, fitting n=2..16 with zero residual).

The research report measured the entire cost baseline inside the research dispatch (lintro term size exactly 5n^2+17n+41 over n=2..16, nested lrewrite exactly 785+346d over d=0..4, per-tier table, 13-row axiom table), so planning did not have to schedule discovery work: every implementation phase is harness check-in that reproduces an already-compiled figure. It also pre-refuted the obvious route by probing '#print axioms P6._example' -> Unknown constant, which forced the named-mirror design before any plan phase could be written against the acceptance fixtures.

Reading context/project/lean4/patterns/plan-authoring-gate-collisions.md before decomposing surfaced four same-phase obligations the research report had not enumerated: (1) .githooks/pre-commit blocks any commit staging a .lean path while typst/generated/status.typ is stale, and tests-file-count/tests-line-count are tracked fields, so every phase adding a Tests/ module owes an in-phase status.typ regeneration; (2) readme-lint.sh Check 1 (gated) requires a README.md in any directory containing .lean files, so BimodalLib/Diagnostics/ owes one; (3) readme-lint.sh Check 4 (gated, ENFORCE_README_DATES=1) makes BimodalLib/README.md's Last verified date newly stale the moment a subdirectory is added; (4) C30 forbids an unscoped set_option maxHeartbeats under FormalSystem/, Tests/ and scripts/, which rules out siting the timing probe under scripts/ and sends it to specs/evidence/ instead. All four are now scheduled phase work rather than mid-phase discoveries.

The research report explicitly deferred one decision to planning: whether the new computable derivation node-count measure lands in FormalSystem/ProofSystem/Derivation.lean beside height, or in BimodalLib/Diagnostics/. Decided for BimodalLib/Diagnostics/ on measured gate cost: touching Derivation.lean would move formalsystem-line-count in typst/generated/status.typ (commit-blocking), go stale the generated inventory row 'Derivation.lean | 418' in FormalSystem/ProofSystem/README.md, move the Live-lines-of-code totals block in README.md, make FormalSystem/ProofSystem/README.md's Last verified date newly stale, and oblige a full lake build --wfail of FormalSystem; siting it in BimodalLib/Diagnostics/ trips none of these four generated surfaces, because status.typ counts FormalSystem/, Tests/ and BimodalTools/ but not BimodalLib/. Recorded as a Decision in the plan with the trade-off stated.

Measuring the 14 audit rows in a scratch lake env lean probe under the REAL target namespace before authoring the test module made Phase 2 a single-build phase: every #guard_msgs expectation was the captured rendered message text, so the module compiled green on the first build with no guard-message iteration. All 14 measured axiom sets matched the research report's Measurement 1 table exactly.

readme-lint Check 3 (broken file references) fired on BimodalLib/Diagnostics/README.md for two FORWARD markdown links to files later phases create (docs/reference/diagnostics.md in Phase 6, Tests/BimodalLibTest/DiagnosticsTest.lean in Phase 4). Check 3 resolves a link target against the filesystem at run time, so a phase-ordered plan that writes a directory README before its siblings cannot use markdown link syntax for them. Resolved by citing both as backticked paths in Phase 3 and promoting each to a link in the phase that creates its target. Not a plan defect: the plan already schedules a return to this README in Phase 4.

Writing a measuring command elaborator in Lean v4.33 hit four distinct non-obvious traps in sequence, each silent or misdiagnosing: (1) a plain string atom in a 'syntax' declaration reserves its spelling as a token for the whole module, so ' stage ' made the field name 'stage' unparseable in the same file's own structure instances -- fixed with non-reserved &" stage " atoms; (2) a 'command' category quotation cannot carry a nested command antiquotation in either a pattern or a term position (command.pseudo.antiquot unimplemented), so wrapping the inner command in set_option is unavailable and arguments must be read positionally from the syntax node; (3) declaration bodies elaborate asynchronously by default, so the wrapped constant is absent from getEnv when the elaborator resumes -- 'set_option Elab.async false' via withScope is required, not a preference; (4) neither whnf at .all transparency nor Meta.reduce with proofs and types unskipped will unfold a structurally recursive measure applied to a closed derivation (both reduce the argument to constructor form and leave the application), so compiled Meta.evalExpr behind @[implemented_by] is the only route -- and it must be built with Meta.mkAppM, since a bare mkApp puts the derivation into the measure's first IMPLICIT slot and fails on a type mismatch that names nothing relevant.

The plan's and the research report's '52 acceptance examples' is the output of grep -c '^example' over the five ProofMode*Test modules, and that count includes #guard_msgs-guarded NEGATIVE fixtures, whose example also begins at column 0. Measured breakdown: ProofModeTest 31/0, ProofModeBooleanTest 6 total of which 4 are guarded, ProofModeModalBooleanTest 4/0, ProofModeTemporalBooleanTest 5/0, ProofModeModalTemporalBooleanTest 6/0 -- 52 example lines, 4 guarded, 48 positive acceptance scripts. The cost probe mirrors the 48: a script asserted to FAIL has no cost worth recording, and mirroring one would have put four deliberately-failing scripts into an evidence probe that is supposed to elaborate clean. Recorded in the probe header and the baseline document rather than silently using either number.

The plan's Phase 7 treats data/ as tracked: it asks for an inventory row in data/README.md and lists data/proof-mode-diagnostics.jsonl plus its sidecar as committed artifacts. Measured: .gitignore line 108 ignores /data outright and 'git ls-files data/' returns ZERO tracked files -- the whole directory is generated-data scratch. The dataset, its sidecar and the README row were written on disk and are correct, but git-commit-scoped.sh dropped all three as gitignored pathspecs. This is the right posture rather than a gap: the regenerating script (scripts/proof-mode-cost-baseline.sh) and the schema it emits against are tracked, so the data is reproducible by one command, which is exactly what the task's DONE WHEN asks for. Recorded in the baseline document so a reader does not look for a committed dataset that this repository deliberately does not carry.

An argument-free 'bash .claude/scripts/verify-touched.sh' for the Phase 8 scoped discharge resolved 14 touched paths from the working tree, five of which it could not map (.githooks/post-checkout, post-commit, post-merge, pre-push -- none of which this task touched, they were already modified in the tree -- plus the brand-new docs/development/proof-mode-cost-baseline.md). The unmapped paths triggered the OWED fallback, which ran the ENTIRE 102-suite agent-system battery under .claude/scripts/tests/ (83 passed, 9 failed: 1 expected, 8 NEW), and then launched a SECOND run-all pass (--cost-class free, 95 suites) that self-deadlocked waiting on /run/user/1000/.gate-lock held by its own first pass -- 165s of [gate-lock-host] waiting with no progress. Torn down via TaskStop. All 8 NEW failures are under .claude/scripts/tests/; this task touched zero paths under .claude/**, so none is attributable to it. Phase 8 discharged instead with the plan's own nine named checks, each scoped to this task's files, plus verify-all.sh as a delta against the Phase 1 baseline. Note for a future dispatch: verify-touched.sh derives touched paths from the WORKING TREE, so a phase that has already committed its Lean work sees only leftover unrelated dirt, and a single unmapped unrelated path escalates the narrow invocation into the exact full sweep the dispatch directive exists to prevent.
